name: Azure infrastructure with Bicep
description: Azure infrastructure managed by Bicep, with scoped validation and what-if review.

definitions.name: Purpose
definitions.defaultText: Make only the agreed Azure infrastructure change. Define the expected resource and operational outcome before editing.

definitions.name: Target environment
definitions.defaultText: Identify tenant, subscription, deployment scope, resource group when relevant, and location. Confirm the active Azure context before cloud operations.

definitions.name: Resource scope
definitions.defaultText: Edit only the named Bicep files and modules. Trace dependencies and flag resource replacements, removals, or scope changes.

definitions.name: Identity and secrets
definitions.defaultText: Use existing RBAC and managed identity or approved secret sources. Do not print credentials or place secrets in source or deployment output.

definitions.name: Deployment context
definitions.defaultText: Inspect existing deployment scope, parameter files, resource locks, and policy constraints. Do not remove locks or bypass policy without separate approval.

definitions.name: Bicep checks
definitions.defaultText: Run az bicep lint and az bicep build on changed files. Report tool or permission gaps rather than claiming a check ran.

definitions.name: What-if review
definitions.defaultText: With authorized Azure access, run the what-if command for the actual deployment scope and parameters. Review creates, changes, deletes, and any results the preview cannot fully resolve.

definitions.name: Deployment approval
definitions.defaultText: Show the tenant, subscription, scope, location, and what-if results. Wait for explicit approval before creating or changing Azure resources.

definitions.name: Deploy
definitions.defaultText: After approval, use the existing deployment pipeline and reviewed parameters. Stop if the target or preview changed and request a new review.

definitions.name: Proof
definitions.defaultText: After authorized deployment, inspect deployment status and relevant resource health. Report actual changes, policy failures, and rollback limits.
